MUFG Investor Services, part of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, provides fund administration, reporting, transaction management, and related services for investment clients. The Junior Software Engineer will support an agile development team by designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions for private equity fund-of-funds, secondary, and co-investment businesses.
Financial Services
Hiring Manager
Aykireh Johnson, MBA, SHRM-CP, ECRE
Responsibilities
Collaboration with team members to design, develop, test, and maintain software applications
Participation in requirements analysis, understanding user needs and translating them into technical specifications
Writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Assisting in troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues reported by users or QA team members
Contributing to architectural design discussions and decisions
Working with version control systems (AzureDevOps Git) to manage code repositories and collaborate with other developers
Participation in SDLC requirements using and maintaining automated CI/CD DevOps pipelines and processes
Staying updated on emerging technologies and industry trends, and proposing innovative solutions to enhance our products
Following agile development methodologies, participation in sprint planning, and delivering features within the established timelines
Documenting software designs, implementation details, and technical specifications
Communicating effectively with team members, sharing progress updates and seeking assistance when needed

Familiarity with software development tools and frameworks (e.g., IDEs, build tools, unit testing frameworks)
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies
Good communication skills, both written and verbal
Prior internship or project experience in software development is a must
Enthusiasm for software engineering and a passion for building high-quality, scalable software solutions
